text:
Maya (People Ops): FYI Anjali handed in resignation today, last day 2025-07-18. Need to coordinate benefits cutoff, COBRA notice timing, badge/swipe return, laptop pickup, and an exit interview. @Sam can you propose deprovision schedule?
Sam (IT Ops): On it. Quick Q: should we keep her Okta account suspended vs disabled immediately? Any ongoing tickets that need transfer?
Diego (Eng Manager): Please suspend at EOD on last day, not before. I'll triage open tickets and reassign this afternoon. Keep Slack access until last working hour so they can finish handoff.
Anjali (Data Scientist): Happy to do detailed handover. I can leave notebooks and a runbook in the repo and schedule a 30-min walkthrough next week. Laptop can be left at reception on 07-19.
Emily (HRBP): Benefits: coverage ends 07-31-2025 (end of month). COBRA election packet will be mailed/electronically sent within 14 days after termination processing. Final benefits-eligible date = 2025-07-18. We'll also confirm short-term disability/other enrollments separately.
Maya (People Ops): Also need final PTO payout calculation and confirmation of equity vesting cutoff. @Emily + Payroll + StockOps?
Emily (HRBP): Yes. Equity: vesting stops on 07-18. StockOps will send specifics; Payroll will confirm final payout date. 401(k): Fidelity will reach out for rollover options.
Sam (IT Ops): Draft deprovision plan:
```
- 2025-07-18 18:00 UTC: suspend Okta (block login)
- 2025-07-19 09:00 UTC: disable Slack account + revoke tokens
- 2025-07-19 10:00 UTC: revoke GitHub personal access tokens, remove org membership (keep any org bots untouched)
- 2025-07-19 11:00 UTC: revoke AWS keys and delete IAM access
- 2025-07-19 11:30 UTC: remove GCP project editor roles (retain read-only analytics role for 30 days if requested)
- 2025-07-19 12:00 UTC: deactivate Jira and Confluence access
- 2025-07-19: Badge deactivated upon laptop dropoff; IT picks up machine for imaging
```
I'll create ticket IT-4410 and tag Diego for approvals.
Diego (Eng Manager): Approved. Please ensure any scheduled cron jobs or alerting runbooks owned by Anjali are transferred to oncall or me.
BadgeBot: Badge deactivation request created BDG-789. Pickup window 2025-07-19 09:00-17:00.
Anjali (Data Scientist): Small ask: could I keep read-only access to the internal docs for 60 days? Need to reference experiment notes.
Sam (IT Ops): We can grant read-only Confluence access for 60 days. I'll add a note to IT-4410.
Maya (People Ops): Exit interview: proposed 2025-07-22 10:00am PT, 30min with me + Emily. Anjali, ok?
Anjali (Data Scientist): Yep, 07-22 works. 30min fine.
Emily (HRBP): Final paycheck will be processed on next regular payroll run; PTO payout will be included per policy. I'll email payroll to confirm exact date and CC you.
Maya (People Ops): Action items recap:
- Anjali: handover doc + short walkthrough (diego@redwood.ai cc)
- Sam: create IT-4410, run deprovision plan, allow 60d read-only Confluence
- Emily: send COBRA packet and loop Payroll/StockOps for final pay + equity
- Diego: reassign tickets and confirm runbook owners
Sam (IT Ops): Example deprovision commands I'll use in ticket: 
```bash
# revoke AWS keys for user
aws iam list-access-keys --user-name anjali | jq -r '.AccessKeyMetadata[].AccessKeyId' | xargs -r -I {} aws iam delete-access-key --user-name anjali --access-key-id {}
# remove from GitHub org
gh api orgs/redwood/memberships/anjali --method DELETE
# suspend Okta
okta-cli users suspend anjali@redwood.ai
```
Diego (Eng Manager): Thanks team. One more: if Anjali has any long-running experiments, snapshot and document where to find outputs.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks all. Will post a short checklist and calendar invites shortly. Good luck Anjali, and we'll be in touch about offboarding docs. :handshake:
